dedupe_keys.name: decarbonizing heating and cooling systems via a 5gdhc network powered by shallow geothermal energy a case study from the catalan pyrenees in the flexgeo project

description: Jordi García-Céspedes and colleagues describe planning a fifth-generation district heating and cooling network for public buildings in Vielha in the Catalan Pyrenees. The case combines shallow geothermal energy with solar photovoltaics. A mainly 2024 field campaign, instrumented boreholes to 100 metres and earlier geophysical campaigns support geological and flow/heat-transport modelling for a borehole field. OpenModelica modelling uses Modelica Buildings and Standard libraries to represent a one-pipe network with a central borefield, covering sports, ice-rink, swimming-pool and education-building loads. The source reports scenario analysis but no quantified achieved operating benefit. Zenodo supplies the paper freely under CC BY 4.0. The related GeoDENs library later includes this use case. A limitation is that the abstract does not establish construction, current operation or access to field observations. No article, sensor values or model code was downloaded.
